face_layer_role: mature front face, calm level brows, two hazel eyes, nose, restrained closed-lip smile, soft cheek lines, ears, neck
braid_layer_role: auburn braided coil LOW at the nape: two plaited masses below the ears with alternating light/dark segments; never a high bun
view_notes: front: auburn hair with upper-left sheen, side-swept fringe and loose face-framing strands; low braided coil at the nape; cool grey-white medical scarf wound at the neck with a knot on the character's right (screen left) and a long tail on the character's left (screen right); ivory open clinician coat over a pale grey-white apron with a restrained botanical hem motif and a charcoal underdress; slim leather belt with brass buckle and small medicine pouch; dark-red emergency bag with brass clasps, leather handle and a rolled bandage at the character's left hip (screen right), hung from a leather cross-body strap with a brass adjuster; small green herb sprig at the character's right chest (screen left); dark gloves; dark-brown leather boots with folded cuffs, brass eyelets and low stacked heels
authored_deviations_from_sheet: The concept sheet's white head-veil/veil is omitted because the Bible identity requires the auburn braided coil LOW at the nape to stay readable; the canonical grey-white medical scarf is worn at the neck instead.
The sheet's long dark-red shawl is reduced to the canonical dark-red emergency bag on the character's left hip; the shawl silhouette is not copied.
Pose: neutral front idle with both arms down; the sheet's 3/4 pose holds an herb sprig. The sprig is kept as a small chest accent.
Fine embroidery, bag contents, tassels and multiple belt charms beyond the botanical hem motif, brass clasps and rolled bandage are omitted for 48 px readability.
